TRP Vulkan NR experimental backend. Engine revision coord-r005, 2026-11-06.

The small-network engine derives from mauri870/DLSSNR-RDNA3
revision a2b4edebcd236c8c6d189b340542ce0bf0c3d673, licensed under MIT.
It retains the inherited mochizuki/Overclockers attribution in LICENSE
and vendor/mauri/THIRD_PARTY.md. Windows portability, opaque cooperative
matrix kernels and the TRP submission adapter are local modifications.
THIRD_PARTY.md is the retained upstream inventory, not this DLL's payload:
OptiScaler, ReShade, MinHook, RenoDX, DXVK and the modified Vulkan loader
listed there are neither compiled into nor shipped with this engine.

No NVIDIA model weights or NVIDIA executable code are included here.
The user-supplied NVIDIA nvngx_dlssnr.dll 310.9.16 is decoded only in RAM,
never executed by this engine and never extracted to files.

Uses the installed Windows Vulkan loader. No loader or validation layer is
bundled or registered. Radeon and Intel execution remain unvalidated.
The RDNA 3 path must pass its fragment-layout probe; otherwise the portable
KHR path is selected if its capabilities pass. Startup driver compilation
can take seconds. Standalone results do not establish Skyrim acceptance.

Build tools: glslang 16.4.0, SPIR-V Tools and Vulkan headers/loader 1.4.357.0,
pinned by TRP's public vcpkg manifest. Generated assets stay in the build tree.
